title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 17.4 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 17.4 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 allowed authenticated users with Maintainer role to make requests to internal network services via the GitLab agent server due to insufficient validation of destination addresses when receptive cluster agents were enabled. This issue has been remediated by GitLab.
